items.title: Coinbase AI blocks $4.7 million deepfake Elon Musk crypto scam
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Coinbase (COIN), saying its AI defenses blocked $4.7 million in customer transfers that were made after a deepfake Elon Musk livestream scam that promised to double any crypto sent.
